# Parity fixtures

Generated by `teratts/export/parity_fixtures.py` from the pinned upstream
`TeraSpace/TeraTTSv2` revision `75983ac96062591d06ecd2ddb2aefb894104bc9e` and
the `teratts-models-v1` bundle. The upstream `teratts.py` is the reference:
the script runs it with one thread and no RUAccent, then stores the text
embedding, the raw duration, the sampled latent and the first 8 192 audio
samples as little-endian `f32` arrays.

`teratts/src/synth.rs` (`mod parity`) replays these arrays through the Rust
sessions and compares them within tolerances. Regenerate only when the
upstream revision or the bundle changes; the test skips without
`TERATTS_BUNDLE`.
